note: Bureau of Reclamation campground on the west shore of Clark Canyon Reservoir (Beaverhead River), ~20 mi S of Dillon. Drive-in tent/trailer sites with three-sided shelters, tables and fire rings; sandy-beach lake access, boat ramp at higher water. Sites can be unlevel. Named for Horse Prairie Creek, not an equestrian camp. --Claude
summary: Reclamation's Clark Canyon brochure confirms vault toilets (two) and hand-pump water, shelters and fire pits. Not stated by any Reclamation page read: site count, RV lengths, booking, stay limit, season; Reclamation's facilities table says campgrounds charge no fee but is undated, so the derived free/FCFS/14-night values were left.
